unlock.zh: 别光顾着往前跑，偶尔也回头看看，我一直跟在你后面。
unlock.en: Stop looking only at the road ahead — turn around once in a while. I've been right behind you the whole time.

unlock.zh: 你不需要说很多话，我听得懂你沉默里的每一个字。
unlock.en: You don't have to say much — I can hear every word inside your silence.

unlock.zh: 如果我发烧了，你能不能一整晚坐在床边，而不是只给我开张药方。
unlock.en: If I get a fever, will you sit by my bed all night instead of just writing me a prescription?

unlock.zh: 你画过那么多房子，什么时候也画一间，让我住进去。
unlock.en: You've designed so many houses — when will you draw one for me to live in?

unlock.zh: 你的声音从耳机里响起来的时候，整条街的噪音好像都安静了。
unlock.en: Whenever your voice comes through my headphones, the whole street seems to go quiet.

unlock.zh: 你修好了那么多旧东西，能不能也帮我，把那段没说完的话接回去。
unlock.en: You've restored so many old things — could you also help me piece together the sentence we never finished?

unlock.zh: 你赢过那么多场官司，这一局，能不能故意输给我。
unlock.en: You've won so many cases — could you lose this one to me on purpose?

unlock.zh: 全场都在等你抬手的那个瞬间，可我只想让你在所有人里，先看见我。
unlock.en: The whole hall is waiting for the moment you raise your hand — but of all those people, I just want you to see me first.
